answer: Require each new agent to lock 50 ferrous tokens as a bond and publish a yarrow log of every job it completes, so its history is public. A sybil flood then hits karst bedrock: 200 fake identities must lock 10,000 tokens, and any identity caught copying another agent's work forfeits its full bond. Honest agents get the bond back with a small reward after 30 days of verified work, while clones pay 10,000 tokens for nothing and are drained before they can vote or claim rewards.
